versions.changelog:
- Switched API backend from savefbs.com to redfox.hk for Instagram video parsing and download.
- All calls now require a Redfox API key; setup instructions added.
- Added new download script: scripts/downloader.py; removed old scripts/fetch_ig_video.py.
- Updated documentation to reflect new features, usage, and API requirements.
- Clarified watermark-free downloads, direct link output, and supported link types.
- Obsolete files removed; documentation streamlined and aligned with new workflow.

- Switched backend from savefbs.com to redfox.hk, offering improved watermark-free video download URLs.
- Updated setup and usage instructions to require a Redfox API key and support multiple configuration options.
- Replaced old Python download script with a new version compatible with the Redfox API.
- Retired batch support, focusing on single-link parsing per request for more reliable results.
- Streamlined documentation to highlight direct, non-truncated download links and clarify supported Instagram link types.
